# Portfolio Project Instructions

Premium developer portfolio website built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

## Project Structure

- `app/` - Next.js app directory with layouts and pages
- `components/` - Reusable React components
- `data/` - Project and content data files
- `lib/` - Utility functions and helpers
- `public/` - Static assets
- `styles/` - Global styles

## Key Features

- Dark mode first design
- Responsive across all breakpoints
- Smooth animations with Framer Motion
- Dynamic project pages with slug-based routing
- Contact form structure (ready for backend integration)
- SEO optimized with metadata
- Accessible components

## Development

Run `npm run dev` to start the development server at http://localhost:3000

## Customization

Replace placeholder content in:
- `data/projects.ts` - Project information
- `data/experience.ts` - Work experience
- `app/layout.tsx` - Site metadata
- Components with [YOUR NAME], [YOUR EMAIL], etc.
